style_header: Photographic texture source for a photorealistic racing game set in Salwa, Kuwait, in 1985. Real photograph, not a render, not an illustration. Shot perfectly straight-on with a long lens so it reads as an orthographic elevation: no perspective, no vanishing lines, verticals perfectly vertical. Soft, even, shadowless daylight (bright overcast) so the game engine can add its own sun and shadows. True-to-life colours, fine surface detail: hairline cracks, dust, water stains, sun bleaching.
must_not: any text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermarks
modern LED lights or modern glass curtain walls

items.prompt: Front elevation of a two-storey 1980s Kuwaiti family villa in Salwa, filling the whole frame edge to edge from the ground line to the top of the roof parapet. Flat roof with a plain parapet. Beige sand-coloured cement plaster, ground floor clad in pale yellow limestone blocks. Rectangular bronze-anodised aluminium windows with tinted glass, each framed by a deep concrete sun-shade box frame. A window air-conditioning unit under two of the upper windows. Central entrance with a heavy dark timber double door under a flat concrete canopy, two marble steps. Small upper balcony with a simple black steel railing.

Front elevation of a two-storey 1980s Kuwaiti villa, filling the whole frame edge to edge from the ground line to the top of the stepped Gulf-style parapet. Off-white plaster gone slightly cream with age, horizontal white bands between floors. Tall narrow windows with pointed Islamic arch heads and white geometric wrought-iron grilles, green-tinted glass. Entrance porch with two round white columns and a timber door. Window AC units, faint rust streaks below them.

Front elevation of a two-storey 1980s Kuwaiti villa, filling the whole frame edge to edge from the ground line to the top of the parapet. Light sandstone-coloured plaster with brown brick-tile accent panels in a geometric pattern between the windows. Wide horizontal ribbon windows with dark brown aluminium frames and folding shutters. A projecting first-floor bay supported on square pillars over a car porch with a pale terrazzo floor. Water stains under the roof line.

Front elevation of a large two-storey 1980s Kuwaiti villa, filling the whole frame edge to edge from the ground line to the top of the parapet. Pinkish-beige plaster, a full-height entrance bay clad in white marble with a large glass and bronze aluminium door, square windows with mashrabiya-style turned-wood screens, a small half-round balcony with a white concrete balustrade. Two window AC units. Sun-faded paint.

Front elevation of a wide single-storey 1980s Kuwaiti house with a flat roof and a stepped parapet, filling the whole frame edge to edge from the ground line to the top of the parapet. Beige plaster with a limestone-block dado, three square bronze aluminium windows with concrete sun-shade frames, a timber entrance door under a small canopy, two window AC units, a white water tank partly visible behind the parapet.

A long straight run of a 2.6 metre high boundary wall of a 1980s Kuwaiti villa, seen straight-on, filling the frame edge to edge left to right and from the pavement line at the bottom to the top of the wall at the top (no sky visible). Beige cement plaster with a band of rough yellow limestone cladding along the bottom metre, a white precast concrete coping along the top, dust and water stains, a few hairline cracks. The wall must continue seamlessly off both the left and right edges, no pillars, no gate, no doors.

A 1980s Kuwaiti villa double driveway gate seen perfectly straight-on, filling the whole frame edge to edge: welded steel painted dark bottle-green, the lower half solid sheet steel with raised rectangular panels, the upper half a decorative Islamic geometric lattice of steel flat bar with gold-painted rosettes, slight rust at the bottom edge, chipped paint. Solid dark background behind the lattice.

A 1980s Kuwaiti villa double driveway gate seen perfectly straight-on, filling the whole frame edge to edge: welded steel painted chocolate brown, vertical bars with spear tips across the top, solid sheet steel panels below with a sunburst motif, slight rust and dust. Solid dark background between the bars.

Seamless tileable square texture of a plain side wall of a 1980s Kuwaiti villa: smooth beige cement plaster with subtle trowel marks, sun bleaching, faint vertical water stains and dust. Fills the whole frame, no edges, no windows.

Seamless tileable square texture of an old Kuwaiti residential street asphalt seen from directly above: grey aggregate bleached by the sun, a light dusting of desert sand, faint tyre polish, a few patched repairs and fine cracks, small oil stains. No road markings. Fills the whole frame.
Seamless tileable square texture of a date palm trunk surface seen straight-on: the overlapping diamond pattern of cut frond bases, fibrous brown-grey bark, dust. Fills the whole frame.

One single complete date palm frond photographed flat from above, isolated on a plain pure white studio background (#FFFFFF), nothing else in the frame: a long central stem running from the bottom centre to the top centre of the image, with stiff green-grey pinnate leaflets on both sides, sun-bleached tips, a few dry yellow leaflets near the base.

Wide photograph of the sky over Kuwait at golden hour in summer, taken from a rooftop looking at the horizon, the horizon line exactly at the bottom edge of the frame with nothing but sky above: pale dusty blue at the top fading to warm peach and soft gold near the horizon, a few thin high streaks of cirrus, the haze of fine desert dust. No sun disc, no buildings, no birds.
